lastResponse.text: This is an emergency. With what she said about hurting herself and now heavier bleeding, call nine one one now. Say: “Two weeks postpartum, suicidal thoughts, and heavier postpartum bleeding.” Stay with her, keep the baby with another safe adult if possible, and don’t leave her alone. If bleeding is soaking a pad in an hour or less, tell nine one one that first. I can stay on the line while you call.
originalTexts: This is an emergency. With what she said about hurting herself and now heavier bleeding, call **911 now**. Say: “Two weeks postpartum, suicidal thoughts, and heavier postpartum bleeding.” Stay with her, keep the baby with another safe adult if possible, and don’t leave her alone. If bleeding is soaking a pad in an hour or less, tell 911 that first. I can stay on the line while you call.
